description: robots.txt URL tester (RFC 9309) — Can this crawler fetch this URL? Tests up to 50 URLs against a site's live robots.txt for up to 10 crawlers at once, using the exact RFC 9309 rules: user-agent group selection (product-token match like Google, falls back to *), longest-match wins, allow wins ties, * and $ wildcards, percent-encoding normalization, /robots.txt always allowed, 4xx = allow all, 5xx/unreachable = disallow all, 500 KiB limit. Returns allowed true/false per URL and crawler with the deciding rule and line, crawl-delay, sitemaps, and lint warnings (unknown directives, rules before user-agent, HTML served as robots.txt). Pass url= (full URLs on one site, separated by newlines or spaces; repeated url= also works), optional ua= (comma list, default *,Googlebot,GPTBot,ClaudeBot,PerplexityBot), or robots= (inline file text, then url= may be plain paths) or domain=. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
